slashCommands.name: clear
slashCommands.description: Start a fresh session (clears context).

slashCommands.name: compact
slashCommands.description: Compact the conversation to free up context.

slashCommands.name: resume
slashCommands.description: Open the session picker / resume a session.

slashCommands.name: fork
slashCommands.description: Fork the current session at the latest message.

slashCommands.name: rename
slashCommands.description: Rename the current session.

slashCommands.name: export
slashCommands.description: Download the current session as plain text.

slashCommands.name: rewind
slashCommands.description: Rewind to a previous user message (use the ↺ buttons).

slashCommands.name: goal
slashCommands.description: Set a goal for this session — shown prominently and tracked until achieved. /goal clear removes it.

slashCommands.name: exit
slashCommands.description: End the current session.

slashCommands.name: permissions
slashCommands.description: Manage allow/ask/deny rules across scopes.

slashCommands.name: sandbox
slashCommands.description: Toggle sandbox mode (OS-level filesystem/network isolation).

slashCommands.name: agents
slashCommands.description: Manage subagent configurations.

slashCommands.name: hooks
slashCommands.description: View hook configurations.

slashCommands.name: mcp
slashCommands.description: Manage MCP servers and OAuth.

slashCommands.name: plugin
slashCommands.description: Manage plugins.

slashCommands.name: reload-plugins
slashCommands.description: Reload plugins to apply changes.

slashCommands.name: reload-skills
slashCommands.description: Pick up skills added or changed on disk during this session.

slashCommands.name: tasks
slashCommands.description: List and manage background tasks.

slashCommands.name: skills
slashCommands.description: List available skills.

slashCommands.name: memory
slashCommands.description: Edit CLAUDE.md, browse memory, toggle auto-memory.

slashCommands.name: context
slashCommands.description: Visualize context window usage.

slashCommands.name: skill-doctor
slashCommands.description: Show per-skill context cost, so you can prune what's not worth it.

slashCommands.name: init
slashCommands.description: Initialize a CLAUDE.md for this project.

slashCommands.name: recap
slashCommands.description: Generate a one-line session summary.

slashCommands.name: btw
slashCommands.description: Side question — ephemeral, no tools, no history.

slashCommands.name: model
slashCommands.description: Switch model (e.g. claude-opus-4-7 / claude-sonnet-4-6), or open the picker with no args.

slashCommands.name: effort
slashCommands.description: Set effort level, or toggle ultracode; open the picker with no args.

slashCommands.name: fast
slashCommands.description: Toggle fast mode, or open the picker with no args.

slashCommands.name: advisor
slashCommands.description: Set the Advisor model (opus/sonnet/fable/off), or open the picker with no args.

slashCommands.name: settings
slashCommands.description: Open the settings editor.

slashCommands.name: theme
slashCommands.description: Pick a color theme.

slashCommands.name: statusline
slashCommands.description: Configure the status line.

slashCommands.name: keybindings
slashCommands.description: Edit keybindings.

slashCommands.name: color
slashCommands.description: Set prompt accent color.

slashCommands.name: diff
slashCommands.description: Show uncommitted changes as an overlay.

slashCommands.name: focus
slashCommands.description: Cycle focus mode (off → focus → zen).

slashCommands.name: output-style
slashCommands.description: List or switch the response output style.

slashCommands.name: zen
slashCommands.description: Toggle Zen mode — hide everything but the chat.

slashCommands.name: tui
slashCommands.description: Switch UI renderer.

slashCommands.name: cost
slashCommands.description: Show session cost & usage as an overlay.

slashCommands.name: usage
slashCommands.description: Open the Usage & account page.

slashCommands.name: extra-usage
slashCommands.description: Configure extra usage for rate-limit recovery.

slashCommands.name: rate-limit-options
slashCommands.description: Show options for handling a usage limit (Usage page).

slashCommands.name: login
slashCommands.description: Sign in to Anthropic.

slashCommands.name: logout
slashCommands.description: Sign out (helper).

slashCommands.description: Configure Amazon Bedrock.

slashCommands.name: setup-vertex
slashCommands.description: Configure Google Vertex AI.

slashCommands.name: feedback
slashCommands.description: Submit feedback via GitHub Issues.

slashCommands.description: Open a chat session in a git worktree.

slashCommands.description: Browse files in the active workspace.

slashCommands.name: batch
slashCommands.description: Large-scale changes across the codebase.

slashCommands.name: claude-api
slashCommands.description: Claude API reference / migration helper.

slashCommands.name: debug
slashCommands.description: Enable debug logging and troubleshoot.

slashCommands.name: fewer-permission-prompts
slashCommands.description: Allowlist common read-only tools.

slashCommands.description: Security review of pending changes.

slashCommands.description: Deep multi-agent code review.

slashCommands.description: Watch PR and auto-fix CI failures.

slashCommands.description: Copy the last response to clipboard.

shortcutActions.label: Next tab
shortcutActions.description: Cycle to the next session tab. Wraps at the end.

shortcutActions.label: Previous tab
shortcutActions.description: Cycle to the previous session tab. Wraps at the start.

shortcutActions.label: Select tab by number
shortcutActions.description: Pressed with 1–9 selects that tab (or the last tab when 9 is pressed and >9 tabs are open).

shortcutActions.label: Next workspace
shortcutActions.description: Cycle to the next workspace in the rail.

shortcutActions.label: Previous workspace
shortcutActions.description: Cycle to the previous workspace in the rail.

shortcutActions.label: Go to workspace 1
shortcutActions.description: Jump to the workspace in position 1 of the rail. No-op when fewer workspaces are configured.

shortcutActions.label: Go to workspace 2
shortcutActions.description: Jump to the workspace in position 2 of the rail. No-op when fewer workspaces are configured.

shortcutActions.label: Go to workspace 3
shortcutActions.description: Jump to the workspace in position 3 of the rail. No-op when fewer workspaces are configured.

shortcutActions.label: Go to workspace 4
shortcutActions.description: Jump to the workspace in position 4 of the rail. No-op when fewer workspaces are configured.

shortcutActions.label: Go to workspace 5
shortcutActions.description: Jump to the workspace in position 5 of the rail. No-op when fewer workspaces are configured.

shortcutActions.label: Go to workspace 6
shortcutActions.description: Jump to the workspace in position 6 of the rail. No-op when fewer workspaces are configured.

shortcutActions.label: Go to workspace 7
shortcutActions.description: Jump to the workspace in position 7 of the rail. No-op when fewer workspaces are configured.

shortcutActions.label: Go to workspace 8
shortcutActions.description: Jump to the workspace in position 8 of the rail. No-op when fewer workspaces are configured.

shortcutActions.label: Go to workspace 9
shortcutActions.description: Jump to the workspace in position 9 of the rail. No-op when fewer workspaces are configured.

shortcutActions.label: New tab
shortcutActions.description: Open a new chat session in a new tab. In the browser build this chord is reserved — remap to Cmd+Shift+N if needed.

shortcutActions.label: Close tab
shortcutActions.description: Close the active tab. On the last remaining tab, opens a fresh chat instead of closing the window.

shortcutActions.label: Reopen closed tab
shortcutActions.description: Restore the most recently closed tab.

shortcutActions.label: Last tab
shortcutActions.description: Jump to the rightmost tab.

shortcutActions.label: Open command palette
shortcutActions.description: Fuzzy-search across nav, sessions, slash commands, and shortcuts.

shortcutActions.label: Toggle sidebar
shortcutActions.description: Show or hide the left navigation rail.

shortcutActions.label: Show keyboard cheatsheet
shortcutActions.description: Open the keyboard-shortcut help overlay.

shortcutActions.label: Find session
shortcutActions.description: Focus the search box on the Sessions page.

shortcutActions.label: Cycle focus mode
shortcutActions.description: Cycle off → focus → zen (hide rails, then everything but chat).

shortcutActions.label: Rename session
shortcutActions.description: Focus the session title input so you can rename the current session.

shortcutActions.label: Zoom window
shortcutActions.description: macOS only — toggle the green traffic-light zoom.

shortcutActions.label: Open Workspace…
shortcutActions.description: Pick a folder to add as a workspace.
